title: Practical context ceiling bound by re-prefill activation, not KV-only arithmetic
citing_run_state: IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL (pilot crashed; not sealed — do not mutate)
finding: At 9114 tokens the analytic KV cache is ~672 MB against a ~2.6 GB model — that should fit under a KV-only capacity story. The C2 pilot instead hit free-memory / paging / canary invalidation because every step re-prefills the whole context (cache probe: no cross-call reuse), so prefill activation memory scales with context on every step. Practical ceiling ~9100 tokens vs architectural 40960 (4.5× below).

contradicts.claim_class: KV-only capacity arithmetic for local context headroom
contradicts.note: Brief is the human's to amend; this note flags the contradiction only.
